manuscript.title: Transformational Intelligence: Learning to Change the Game
manuscript.author: Vincent Boucher

charter.purpose: Develop and model a non-safety-critical autonomous optimization foundry that provides useful policy prototypes and auditable handoffs under the buyer's original objective.
materialConstraints: Fresh evaluation against the original outcome objective
Explicitly scoped prototype/handoff, not physical or safety-critical deployment
Public or synthetic inputs; no confidential client material
Full construction, search, failure, validation, maintenance and business cost
Finite available cash and preserved obligations
charter.authorityBoundary: No paid access purchase, credentials, financial transactions, security changes, contract/settlement changes or bypasses.
charter.priorStudyRelation: New authorized charter; old outcomes and criteria are preserved without inheriting their documentation workload, prices, review policy or two-investment success definition.

witnessFields.studyRecord: New venture charter, buyer need, original objective, hard constraints and authorized amendments.
witnessFields.claimBoundary: A new formulation is judged by the original objective; a new authorized end is a new comparison.

witnessFields.studyRecord: Candidate-specific obstruction, provenance and evidence that it is a removable inherited means rather than a required constraint.
witnessFields.claimBoundary: Do not assume a fixed service/draft workflow is the user's economic objective.

witnessFields.studyRecord: Executable policy-construction or production architecture; typed representation, composition, required inputs, deployment scope and fallback.
witnessFields.claimBoundary: Proposals, modeled capabilities, executed finite computations and live performance are separate evidence categories.

witnessFields.studyRecord: Machine constraint witness plus fresh original-objective evaluation, separately from purchase, business value and real operational deployment.
witnessFields.claimBoundary: A constraint check is not economic adoption or physical-world safety validation.

witnessFields.studyRecord: Counterexample that violates a required constraint; held-out objective degradation; expensive construction/verification; scope shift; failure to obtain modeled adoption or repay complete cost.
witnessFields.claimBoundary: Retain rejection and inconclusive outcomes; a stopped proposal can be the correct action.

witnessFields.studyRecord: Matched original-purpose alternative, unchanged formulation, structural ablation, full resource accounting and same authorized opportunities.
witnessFields.claimBoundary: A commercial result and a stronger formulation-causality claim need different evidence; no artificial weak baseline.

witnessFields.studyRecord: Frozen candidate/configuration/outcome bridge; fresh seeds/tasks or campaigns at the appropriate unit; declared uncertainties; preserved failed attempts.
witnessFields.claimBoundary: Monte Carlo uncertainty does not calibrate unmeasured market, skill or frontier-model assumptions.

witnessFields.studyRecord: Supported instance family, feasibility/goal semantics, source and checker identities, dependencies, scope/freshness/revocation, maintenance and retirement triggers.
witnessFields.claimBoundary: Inheritance does not transfer current proof or execution authority, and successful parts do not guarantee a successful composition.

structuralOperators.representation: Typed policy and constraint structures preserving distinctions needed by the original objective.
structuralOperators.information: Acquire or generate discriminating tests where permitted; no access expansion.
structuralOperators.dependency: Expose genuinely independent construction/checking work and preserve required dependencies.
structuralOperators.production: Produce the policy and inspectable constraint/outcome evidence together where that reduces full cost.
structuralOperators.taskBoundary: Consider delivering reusable decision capability or removing recurring work if authorized by the venture purpose.
structuralOperators.mechanism: Use explicit handoff and asset-use rules, with separate commercial participation and cash accounts.
structuralOperators.evaluation: Propose better outcome instruments only with separate justification, common rescoring and retained prior epochs.

missingUntilStudyExecution: Candidate-specific evidence of a binding restriction
New source-linked commercial and frontier capability calibration
A frozen new-study protocol and its outcomes
